summary: Firelookout.ca lists a Mountain Ash tower in Algoma District by location only; no second source was found for its history, condition or access.
notes_for_editor: Only one source: the Firelookout.ca catalogue entry, which gives coordinates and location only. Its elevation, tower type, structure height and year built are all N/A, and the entry says 'No information is available.' Two web searches found nothing else; the Forest Rangers still-standing list does not name this tower. A 'Fire Tower Mountain' near Blind River turned up in search, but it is a different peak and was not used. The story is far below the 120-word floor because the record is this thin; recommend the editor decide whether to publish it as a stub or hold it. Brief status and access were 'unknown' and are left unset.
